Definition: to slice, i.e. break open or pierce
BiblicalUsage: 1) to cleave, slice; 1a) (Qal) to cleave, plow; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to cleave open or through; 1b2) to cause to cleave open; 1b3) to slice, pierce
